task_description: Automate PR creation in auto-claude workflow after QA approval, eliminating manual terminal operations and enabling GitHub-based human review with visible CI status

auto-claude-mcp-server: workflow state machine (where human_review status transitions occur)

patterns.pr_creation_pattern: git push -u origin <branch> && gh pr create --base staging --title '...' --body '...'
patterns.pr_body_format:
Closes #<issue>

[desc]

[why]

[how]

existing_implementations.description: Current workflow sets status to human_review after QA approval and staging. PR creation is a manual terminal operation by the user.

external_dependencies.note: The auto-claude MCP server is EXTERNAL to this repository. Implementation requires access to that server's source code.
